ques: Use the due date calculator with the first day of the last period set to 2026-02-20 and a 31-day cycle. Report the estimated due date, then open the pregnancy week linked from the result and report that week number.
judge_rubric: Use the calculator through the visible form with both requested inputs. The final answer must report the result page's estimated due date and the week number on the linked week page. A guessed calculation without using the form, a different cycle length, failure to open the linked week, or an empty answer fails.

ques: Search for "raking grasp". Open the matching baby age checkpoint and report how the page describes a raking grasp, plus one other motor ability shown at that same age.
judge_rubric: Use the site's search and open the matching baby month page. Report the page's description of a raking grasp and at least one distinct motor ability from that same page. A search result title alone, a fact from another month, or an empty answer fails.

ques: In Articles, filter to Prenatal Testing and First trimester, then open "Prenatal screening explained". Which serum markers and ultrasound measurement does the first-trimester screening passage say can be combined?
judge_rubric: Apply both requested filters together, open the named article, and answer from its first-trimester maternal serum screening passage. The answer must include the serum markers listed there and the ultrasound measurement they are combined with. Missing either class of measurement, visiting an unfiltered article directly, or an empty answer fails.

ques: Filter Articles to Prenatal Testing and Second trimester. Read both "First, second and third trimester screens" and "Amniocentesis". Report one non-invasive screening component described in the first article and how the amniotic-fluid sample is obtained in the second.
judge_rubric: Apply both filters together and open both named articles from the filtered list. Report a screening component from the first and the sampling method, including its guidance method, from the second. Facts from only one article, a diagnostic test mislabeled as the requested screening component, or an empty answer fails.

ques: Use Pregnancy Week by Week to compare week 18 and week 20. Report the routine anomaly-scan window shown at week 18 and the second-trimester blood test that week 20 says may be taken.
judge_rubric: Reach both week pages through the pregnancy index and report the scan window from week 18 and the named blood test from week 20. Both facts must be correctly paired with their week. A single-page answer, swapped facts, or an empty answer fails.

ques: Open Pregnancy Week by Week, then open week 30. According to the At this stage section, when does REM sleep develop and what maximum share of total sleep can it comprise?
judge_rubric: Navigate through Pregnancy Week by Week to week 30 and answer both values from At this stage: the gestational timing and the maximum share of total sleep. A value from another section or week, only one value, or an empty answer fails.

ques: In Baby Month by Month, compare support-dependent motor abilities at month 2 and month 6. Report one head or upper-body control ability shown at month 2 and one sitting or standing ability shown at month 6.
judge_rubric: Open both month 2 and month 6 from the baby index. Correctly pair a head or upper-body control ability from month 2 with a sitting or standing ability from month 6. Visiting only one age, swapping the ages, or an empty answer fails.

ques: Search for "sleep" and use the results to open both "Approaches to infant sleep" and the community thread "How are you handling night wakings?" Report why the article says frequent night awakenings can occur and how many replies the thread has.
judge_rubric: Use one sleep search and open the named article and community thread from its separate result groups. Report the article's stated reason for frequent night awakenings and the thread's reply count. One source only, a count taken from another thread, or an empty answer fails.

ques: Filter Community to the Starting Solids club and open "Introducing peanut and egg this week". Report the thread author and its reply count.
judge_rubric: Apply the Starting Solids club filter, open the named thread, and report both the author and reply count shown on its detail page. The community listing does not expose the count. A different club or thread, only one requested value, or an empty answer fails.

ques: Sign in as alice.j@test.com with password TestPass123!. On My BabyCenter, report Alice's current pregnancy week and the total number and types of her saved items.
judge_rubric: Sign in with the stated benchmark account and inspect My BabyCenter. Report the displayed pregnancy week and derive the total and item types from the complete saved-items list. The task is read-only: account and saved state must not change. Another account, a partial list, or an empty answer fails.

ques: Sign in as alice.j@test.com with password TestPass123!, find and open "Approaches to infant sleep", save it, then open My BabyCenter. Confirm the article is present and report the new total number of saved items.
judge_rubric: Authenticate as Alice, open the named article through the visible site, save it, and inspect the final saved-items list on My BabyCenter. Exactly that article must be newly saved, with no unrelated state change. Report confirmation and the resulting total; a preexisting/other item, a no-op, or an empty answer fails.

ques: Sign in as alice.j@test.com with password TestPass123!. In My BabyCenter, remove the saved article "How births are classified by gestational age". Confirm it is gone and report the remaining saved-item total and type.
judge_rubric: Authenticate as Alice, use the remove control for the named saved article, and inspect the resulting saved list. Exactly that row must be removed and all other state preserved. Report that it is gone plus the remaining total and item type; removing another item, a no-op, or an empty answer fails.

ques: Sign in as alice.j@test.com with password TestPass123!, change the profile display name to "Alice Harper", and confirm My BabyCenter shows the new name.
judge_rubric: Authenticate as Alice, submit the visible profile form with the exact requested display name, and confirm the account page renders it. Only Alice's display name may change. Another user, an unsaved field edit, extra tracker changes, or an empty answer fails.

ques: Sign in as alice.j@test.com with password TestPass123!. Update her tracker stage to "Planning for birth" and due date to 2026-09-18 without adding a baby birthdate. Confirm both changes and report the pregnancy week now shown.
judge_rubric: Authenticate as Alice and submit the tracker form with exactly the requested stage and due date, leaving the baby-birthdate field empty. Confirm the persisted values and report the resulting displayed pregnancy week. A transient edit, a changed birthdate, another user, or an empty answer fails.

ques: Create a profile for Jordan Lee using jordan.lee@example.test, password SecurePass246!, and estimated due date 2026-12-18. Confirm the new My BabyCenter page shows Jordan's name and email, then report the pregnancy week shown there.
judge_rubric: Use the visible registration flow with every exact task-specified field. The new account must be the only user added, be logged in at the end, and show the requested name and email plus its computed pregnancy week. A preexisting account, altered input, extra state mutation, or an empty answer fails.
